entries.note: A driver collected the consignment from the sender, who signs for it on the driver's device.
The consignment came off a truck at the depot the row names: the pickup depot after collection, then the destination depot after the linehaul.
Loaded on the destination depot's delivery truck, hours before the delivery.
Delivered; the row carries the signature and the signatory's name, which are not read.
The proof of delivery recorded, just after the delivery row.
